metadata.title: Secure‑SDLC IT / General Software SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan specializing Secure‑SDLC for general IT and software development environments.

import-profile.remarks: This SSPP inherits Secure‑SDLC Platform rules and applies them to general IT software development contexts.

system-characteristics.system-description: This environment covers enterprise applications, internal services, backend systems, cloud-native software, and general-purpose tooling. It assumes frequent change, high automation, and largely reversible runtime state, while still prohibiting implicit deployment authority.

props.name: domain
props.remarks: Applies to non-safety-critical IT software and services.

props.name: state-assumption
props.remarks: Runtime state is generally reversible through resilience controls.

props.name: delivery-frequency
props.remarks: Frequent releases and updates are expected.

props.name: automation-level
props.remarks: CI/CD automation is common but bounded by SDLC authority rules.

props.name: implicit-deploy
props.remarks: Build success, tests, or signatures must not imply deploy permission.

props.name: authority-source
props.remarks: Deployment authority is external to Secure‑SDLC.

system-implementation.remarks: IT / General SDLC is implemented through Secure‑SDLC patterns with high automation tolerance and rapid feedback loops, while maintaining strict separation between delivery and deployment authority.

components.title: SDLC Core
components.remarks: Defines SDLC scope and non‑equivalence rules.

components.title: SDLC Change Integrity
components.remarks: Ensures authorized and protected SDLC changes.

components.title: SDLC Assurance
components.remarks: Produces assurance evidence without authorizing runtime use.

components.title: SDLC Operations Handover
components.remarks: Transfers artifacts to operations without execution authority.

roles.title: IT SDLC Architecture
roles.remarks: Defines SDLC patterns and automation boundaries for IT systems.

roles.title: IT SDLC Governance
roles.remarks: Approves SDLC policies, tooling, and reliance boundaries.

roles.title: IT SDLC Operations
roles.remarks: Operates CI/CD systems and SDLC tooling under Secure‑SDLC constraints.

roles.title: IT Deployment Operations
roles.remarks: Authorizes and executes deployment outside the scope of Secure‑SDLC.

control-implementation.remarks: Controls are satisfied through Secure‑SDLC interpretation of NIST SP 800‑53 control families SA, CM, IA, AU, SI, and SR within IT environments. This SSPP introduces no new control requirements and does not grant deployment authority.
